svg.aria-label: A made-up reading example over four stages. Upper lane: E4 from 0 to 1, a rest from 1 to 2, F4 from 2 to 4. Lower lane: C4 from 0 to 4. A dashed vertical line at stage 3 crosses F4 above C4.
svg.title: Reading a two-lane timeline

g.text: Each voice gets its own lane
Made-up pattern, only to show how a lane reads. Not a Week 2 exercise.
How to read this graphic: The top lane is the upper voice and the bottom lane is the
lower voice. A solid bar is a note sounding for as long as the bar is wide; a dashed box
is a rest. The dashed vertical line cuts through both lanes at one moment, and the two
notes it crosses are the pair sounding together. This pattern is made up to show how to
read a lane; it is not a Week 2 exercise.
